summary: Add default-off, one-request private phase diagnostics for conversation relays

replay.detail: No replay, backfill, derived state or conversation content storage is introduced.

schema.detail: No table, index, migration or schema version changes.

rules.detail: No claim, checkpoint, signature, admission or retention rules change.

compatibility.detail: Existing requests, signed bodies and headers, response envelopes, authority, routing, limits and deadlines are preserved; selected traces reuse the existing response UUID and authenticated body digest.

downtime.detail: This change adds no service interruption beyond the existing deployment lifecycle. Diagnostics remain disabled unless explicitly selected before process startup.

manual.detail: No mandatory operator action. Any optional private diagnostic selection or live activation remains a separately scoped operational decision.

recovery.detail: No durable state to recover. One-shot selectors and bounded trace state are process-local and are discarded at exit.
